name: Freshworks CRM
label: Freshworks CRM (Freshsales) REST — contacts, accounts, deals
description: Official Freshsales / Freshworks CRM REST (unversioned) at https://{bundleAlias}.{hostSuffix}/crm/sales/api. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth: Authorization: Token token=<apiKey>. List endpoints need a saved view_id. trigger.listen is ingress — there is no REST webhook-subscribe; use Freshsales Workflow “Trigger webhook” into a BPMN message event. Customer owns the CRM tenant. Do not call Freshdesk/Freshservice from this node. apiKey is never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. JSON wrappers: contact, sales_account, deal, appointment, task, note. Do not put apiKey here. Example: {"operation":"contact.get","id":"123"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verbs: contact.* account.* deal.* appointment.* task.* note.* salesActivity.get | salesActivity.list | trigger.listen. trigger.listen never opens a socket.

schema.label: view_id
schema.description: Saved filter/view id required for contact.list / account.list / deal.list (not a bare collection GET).

schema.label: page
schema.description: 1-based page. Default 25 rows/page on list views.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Official list query filter= for appointment.list / task.list / salesActivity.list.

schema.label: contact
schema.description: contact.create / contact.update official {contact:{first_name, last_name, email, ...}} wrapper. Keep as the API object.

schema.label: appointment
schema.description: Official wrapper for appointment.create / appointment.update. title required.

schema.label: task
schema.description: Official wrapper for task.create / task.update. title required.

schema.label: note
schema.description: Official wrapper for note.create / note.update. description + targetable_type + targetable_id on create.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Per-user key from Profile → API Settings (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Token token=<apiKey>. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Bundle alias
configurationParameters.description: Freshworks bundle alias / subdomain only (acme in acme.myfreshworks.com). Substituted as baseUrl host. Hostname only — no scheme, no IPs. Profile → API Settings.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
